title: Dua of Covenant with Almighty Allah (s.w.t)
data:
Eleventh: al-Tusi, al-Kaf'ami, and other scholars have reported that the Holy Prophet (s) said to his companions, "Will you be too feeble to make a covenant with Almighty Allah every morning and evening?" "How can we do that?" they asked. The Holy Prophet (s) instructed, "Say this supplicatory covenant. When you do so, the covenant will be sealed and put under the Divine Throne. On the Resurrection Day, a caller will call out for those who have made a covenant with the All-beneficent Lord; you will then be given that covenant and allowed to enter Paradise." Shaykh al-Tusi has mentioned this supplicatory covenant, to be said after the dawn (fajr) Prayer:
اَللّٰهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمٰوَاتِ وَالْاَرْضِ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الرَّحْمٰنَ الرَّحِيْمَ اَعْهَدُ اِلَيْكَ فِىْ هٰذِهِ الدُّنْيَا اَنَّكَ اَنْتَ اللّٰهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَكَ وَ اَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ اٰلِهٖ عَبْدُكَ وَ رَسُوْلُكَ
ALLAAHUMMA FAATIRAS SAMAAWAATI WAL ARDI A'AALIMAL GHAYBI WASH SHAHAADATIR RAHMAANAR RAHEEM, A'-HADU ILAYKA FEE HAAZIHID DUNYAA ANNAKA ANTALLAAHU LAA ILAAHA ILLAA ANTA WAHDAKA LAA SHAREEKA LAK, WA ANNA MUHAMMADAN SALLALLAAHU A'LAYHI WA AALIHI A'BDUKA WA RASOOLUK
O Allah, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the seen, the All-beneficent, the All-merciful: I make this covenant with You in this world, that You are Allah — there is no god except You, alone, without partner — and that Muhammad, Allah's blessings be upon him and his Household, is Your servant and Your messenger,
اَللّٰهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِهٖ وَ لَا تَكِلْنِىْ اِلٰى نَفْسِىْ طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ اَبَدًا وَ لَاۤ اِلٰى اَحَدٍ مِّنْ خَلْقِكَ فَاِنَّكَ اِنْ وَّكَلْتَنِىْۤ اِلَيْهَا تُبَاعِدْنِىْ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ وَ تُقَرِّبْنِىْ مِنَ الشَّرِّ اَىْ رَبِّ لَاۤ اَثِقُ اِلَّا بِرَحْمَتِكَ
ALLAAHUMMA FASALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIHI WA LAA TAKILNEE ILAA NAFSEE TARFATA A'YNIN ABADAN WA LAA ILAA AHADIM MIN KHALQIKA, FA-INNAKA IW WAKALTANEE ILAYHAA TUBAA-I'DUNEE MINAL KHAYRI WA TUQARRIBUNEE MINASH SHARR, AY RABBI LAA ASIQU ILLAA BI-RAHMATIK
so send blessings upon Muhammad and his Household, and do not entrust me to myself for the blink of an eye, ever, nor to any of Your creatures — for if You entrust me to it, it will distance me from good and bring me near to evil. O my Lord, I trust in nothing except Your mercy;
فَصَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِهِ الطَّيِّبِيْنَ وَاجْعَلْ لِّىْ عِنْدَكَ عَهْدًا تُؤَدِّيْهِ اِلَىَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ اِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيْعَادَ
FASALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALIHIT TAYYIBEEN WAJ-A'L LEE I'NDAKA A'HDAN TU-ADDEEHI ILAYYA YAWMAL QIYAAMAH, INNAKA LAA TUKHLIFUL MEE-A'AD
so send blessings upon Muhammad and his pure Household, and grant me with You a covenant which You shall deliver to me on the Day of Resurrection; verily You do not break the promise.
Twelfth: in the book 'Uddat al-Da'i, it is recorded that Imam al-Sadiq (a) has said: he who invokes Almighty Allah's blessings upon the Holy Prophet and his Household using this form after the dawn (fajr) Prayer, before speaking, Almighty Allah will save his face from being burnt with Hellfire:
رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اَهْلِ بَيْتِ مُحَمَّدٍ
RABBI SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMADIN WA AHLI BAYTI MUHAMMAD
My Lord, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.
In his book Thawab al-A'mal, Ibn Baabwayh has reported the following through a valid chain of authority: in order that Almighty Allah save your face from being burnt with Hellfire, repeat the following invocation of blessings one hundred times after the dawn (fajr) Prayer:
اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
ALLAAHUMMA SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMAD
O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad.
According to another tradition, repeat the following invocation of blessing and supplicatory prayer one hundred times before you say any other word, after the accomplishment of a ritual prayer:
يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ اَعْتِقْ رَقَبَتِىْ مِنَ النَّارِ
YAA RABBI SALLI A'LAA MUHAMMADIN WA AALI MUHAMMADIN WA A'-TIQ RAQABATEE MINAN NAAR
O my Lord, send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad, and free my neck from the Fire.
